problem_statement: Calling ztimer64_set() on a newly initialized ztimer64 clock with a ztimer64_t that is not actually part of that clock can crash. For example, a timer struct with only base.target set, but not inserted into the clock, must be accepted by ztimer64_set() without causing an abort when the clock has no timers yet.

verification.reason: The statement already describes the required behavior and edge case that the hidden test checks: ztimer64_set() must not abort on a newly initialized empty clock when called with a timer that is not part of the clock, with only base.target set. All needed API names and types already exist in the repository.
